description: Every builtin documented in builtins.md, with one example program per target. Each program is a complete SauceScript module (entry main.js). Compile it with @eco-incorp/sauce/compiler for that target; it must compile. For each `unavailable` entry, compiling `program` for that target must fail with a message containing `error`. Items listing `contracts` need those ABIs passed as inlineContracts: [[name, abis[name]]].
